body:
Dear friend,

My pantry is bursting with summer: figs, jam, nuts and more. But the jars all look alike!

Will you come and help me label them? It's the last job of our farm fortnight.
summary: Label the jars in the summer pantry.

tasks.where: in Mrs. Hannah's farmhouse (walk the farm road, or take the map)
from the jug in your kitchen
